Game Overview

In Destroy Asteroids, the core idea is straightforward: become Earth's last hope in Destroy Asteroids. Navigate your fighter plane through perilous asteroid belts with precision aiming and strategic missile deployment. Dodge threats, conserve ammo, and clear paths to launch a Mars-bound missile. Challenge your skills in this adrenaline-pumping cosmic defense mission.
